A {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is a place where you can have a {{item|zombie}} grow your crops. Those farms come in 3 tiers: {{quality|copper}}, {{quality|silver}} and {{quality|gold}}, where you can only grow basic crops or crops of that tier or below.{{clear}}

==Cost==
'''Note:''' The fields must '''not''' be tilled before, otherwise you are not able to build the farm. You can remove tilled fields using the [[kitchen garden]] workbench.

==Upgrading the Farm==
You need to build a tier I farm first. Then you may upgrade it to tier II and afterwards to tier III. You have to use the [[fertilizer]] only once to upgrade the farm, it lasts forever.

Upgrading the farm to a higher tier has the following effects:

==Working the Farm==
Take a {{item|zombie}} near the farm, hit "E" to put it to work, and "E" again to remove it from the farm. Stand next to the zombie, hit "E" to select, and then select which crop should be produced or upgrade the farm.

It takes a while for the crops to be produced - the higher the tier of the farm and the higher the work effiency of the zombie, the faster they work. You'll see a progress bar below the crop that's currently produced. After a while the products are stored automatically in a [[trunk]] of the [[kitchen garden]]. This sign [[file:work blocked.png|work blocked]] on the farm means that the trunk is full (or missing) and the work is blocked until some storage space is freed up (or constructed).
